title: Largest Positive Integer That Exists With Its Negative
summary: In an integer array without zeros, identify the greatest positive integer k for which -k also appears in the array.
statement: In an integer array without zeros, identify the greatest positive integer k for which -k also appears in the array. Return k. If no such integer exists, return -1.
constraints: Find a positive integer k for which both k and -k occur in nums.
Return -1 when no positive/negative pair exists; zero does not qualify.
hints: Put all input values in a set.
Inspect positive values whose negation is also in the set.
Return the maximum qualifying value, using -1 when the candidate set is empty.
Set membership checks both signs directly, and maximizing the complete candidate set applies the requested choice.
editorial: Set membership checks both signs directly, and maximizing the complete candidate set applies the requested choice.

tests.explanation: Both three and negative three occur, and three is the greatest qualifying value.
One and seven have negatives present, so seven is returned.
